supplementalSource.role: SPT-4.1 supplemental compatibility/content reference; does not replace the pinned canonical legacy corpus

legacyReserve.reason: Gear-restricted elimination mastery repeats the same design space already represented by bounded protection/loadout operations. Useful equipment constraints may inform those operations, but no separate gear-mastery ladder is admitted.

Ten-step skill-level ladders per skill reward passive character progression rather than an authored Admiral operation. They duplicate organic skill advancement and create notification/reward volume without a distinct tactical problem.
Meta mastery of whole skill categories is character-progression bookkeeping rather than specialist field work. It adds no distinct Why/What/Context/Payoff beyond reaching skill thresholds.
Weapon-group elimination ladders duplicate the seven-family Arsenal capability model. Weapon-group coverage may be used to audit family pools, but the 1/3/6/9/... kill conveyor is not admitted.

classes.reason: These are half-bundle substitutions of already reviewed proficiency/equipment content, not additional quest concepts.
Difficulty/order variants do not create a new authored operation; Admiral owns one curated progression rather than user-swappable duplicate chains.
They duplicate Mechanic Gunsmith handover/progression and have no distinct Admiral field purpose.
They duplicate hideout construction requirements and are explicitly outside Admiral's curated specialist campaign.
Never-completing scoreboard quests are telemetry/UI concepts, not Admiral operations or progression rewards.
